build_configuration: CUDA12.8 / MSVC Release / compute7.5 / C++20 / no fast math
dispatch: Only existing bounded large reflection groups using prepared mirrors use a new candidate kernel; all other paths unchanged.
semantics: Keep every candidate, original ordinal/tie, FP64 expressions and mirror updates. A warp hash proposes peers but all192 mirror bits must match before sharing normalization. Hash collisions execute the original lane arithmetic. No approximate reciprocal, precision change or persistent cache.
tradeoff: No new persistent GPU allocation; one new kernel with warp match/shuffle and exact-bit comparison overhead. Existing12 GPU kernels must remain byte-identical in normalized SASS/resources.
performance_gate: At least5% complete public trace reduction on realistic large mirrored batches with4/5 improving final rounds, exact outputs and no material controls/cold regression. Reject promptly after an ineffective or nonidentical early gate.

decision.reason: Every measured public trace median regressed; no meaningful speedup. Stop before broad candidate validation, regression or sanitizer runs.

measured_stage_label_note: The reused helper calls the native reflection stage unchanged_warm_multipath, a legacy label. This probe changes that stage; unchanged applies only to LOS and the retained original12 kernel bodies.
measurement_method: Own process pinned to one allowed CPU, normal priority; sequential whole calls; alternating build order each repetition and round; nonexclusive host
measurement_scope: native reflection/public LOS+reflection/native owner construction+first trace+close/LOS; includes validation, H2D, all kernels, synchronization and returned arrays; CPU BVH construction and output hashing excluded
limits: This144-pair early performance gate is not broad accuracy or CUDA-sanitizer certification for the rejected candidate.
All measured complete public trace medians regressed0.30..0.50%; no speedup is claimed. No positioning-error, PF/GNSS/IMU or IQ performance change is adopted.
No hardware counter or achieved-occupancy claim. The new kernel uses78 registers,5120 static shared bytes,0 stack/local, as does the original shared-mirror candidate kernel.
